The second annual return stacking symposium is coming to Chicago on October 28, 2026, headlined by Cliff Asnes, founder and CIO of AQR. It's a full day of conversations on how to stack return streams, put your capital to work more efficiently, and rethink the way you build portfolios.

thesis: Ben Wellington explains that in quantitative investing, a feature is a fact about the world that is economically meaningful, ranging from simple technical metrics like price changes to more complex derived data like news coverage trends. He notes that while raw data is becoming commoditized, the competitive edge increasingly comes from the specific features built out of that data.
